title: The MK Free Set
text:
The MK Free Set.
The better for you boards. A duo of plant-based boards you'll reach for daily, thanks to their non-porous and dishwasher-safe material. Messy, large jobs are perfect for The MK Free Board's expansive size and juice groove. Small daily tasks are where The Midi MK Free Board shines thanks to its versatile size and grippy silicone corners, making it perfect for slippery counters and cooking with young chefs.
Selected option: Cloud / Tide.

title: The Matte Set
text:
The Matte Set.
Understated, not unnoticed. The 20-piece Matte Set brings a quiet kind of polish to the table. Made from premium 18/10 stainless steel with a matte finish, the full set creates four complete place settings that look just as right with everyday ceramics as they do at a dinner party. Very good design. A refreshingly sensible price. No need to save these for the nice plates or the right guests. This first release is available in limited quantities.

title: The Mirror Set
text:
The Mirror Set.
The good silverware (20 pieces, in fact). Every single day. With a polished, light-catching finish, The Mirror Set makes even a Tuesday-night dinner feel like someone put in a little effort. Twenty pieces of premium 18/10 stainless steel make four complete place settings, without the precious price tag. Good-looking enough for company. Practical enough for everyone else. This is flatware you’ll want to put out, not put away. We’re introducing it in limited quantities for the first release.

title: The Host Set
text:
The Host Set.
For the host who has everything. Almost. The Host Set pairs two of our most-loved table pieces: The Salt Sphere and The Resting Stone. One keeps the finishing salt close. The other gives serving spoons and small essentials somewhere beautiful to land. Both deserve to stay out long after the guests have gone. Back by popular demand. Not for long. We brought The Host Set back in a very limited quantity, and we don’t expect it to stick around. If it’s been on your list, this would be the time.
Selected option: Walnut + Seaglass.

title: Dinner Plate Set of 4
text:
Dinner Plate Set of 4.
At the heart of Tortugaware’s dinner plate lies the sculpted edge—a distinctive form that engages the eye and welcomes the hand. Designed to feel extraordinary in the hands and to stack like sculptures, these modern stoneware dinner plates build undulating landscapes across the table. Each plate has a substantial clay body that gives it weight, presence, and durability for modern living. Microwave, dishwasher, and oven safe up to 300°F. Made in Mexico. MK Finds items are not eligible for discounts.
Selected option: Bone.

title: The Bestsellers Set
text:
The Bestsellers Set.
Our most-recommended kitchen upgrades. In one set. The Bestsellers Set brings together three favorites for a reason: The Forever Peeler, The Table Knives and The MK Free Board. Small changes to the things you use all the time, and a surprisingly big difference in how you prep, cook and eat. A good place to start. An even better gift. The Forever Peeler makes quick work of produce with its weighted feel and replaceable blade. The Table Knives bring a clean, straight-edge cut to dinner. And the non-porous, dishwasher-safe MK Free Board offers a smarter alternative to wood and conventional fossil-based plastic. We’ve put this combination together in limited quantities for the holiday season.
Selected option: Morel / Cloud.

title: The Clean Cook Set
text:
The Clean Cook Set.
Clean eating starts with what's on your counter, including your tools. Plant-based and free of permanent microplastics, The MK Free Board™️ is the perfect pairing for The 8" Knife, a balanced, sharp and safe knife that tackles almost every job you have in the kitchen. Easy to use, easy to care for and worry-free, these foundational tools make prep a breeze and clean-up a no-brainer. They're so good, you'll want to cook more.
Selected option: Shell / Cool Neutral.

title: The Good Prep Set
text:
The Good Prep Set.
Chop, slice and dice with confidence. The foundation of any kitchen: the right cutting board and a sharp knife. The Good Prep Set has you covered with our 100% plant-based cutting board (free of permanent micro-plastics, non-porous and dishwasher-safe) and our trio of three essential knives, including a perfectly balanced steel 8" chef's knife, 6" serrated knife and almost 4" paring knife.
Selected option: Ocean / Cool Neutral.
